description: a stadium, two straight sides of length 2 joined by two half circles of radius R 1, extruded 1 high, with its whole top outline filleted at r 0.25 in one call: line, arc, line, arc, a closed chain whose four vertices are tangent. The blend is two half cylinders along the sides and, over each half circle, half a torus of major radius R − r and minor r, each pair of stripes ending on one shared cross-section arc at a tangent vertex. The removed corner's section (1 − π/4) r² is swept 2 + 2 along the sides and a full turn about the round ends' common radius R − r (10 − 3π) / (12 − 3π) by Pappus. Arris refuses it today at the first edge it meets: Unsupported (a circle curve against a plane) at an arc, TangentChain at a line whose end sits at a tangent junction
